summary: Colonial SFL, Socimi S. A. is the leading platform in the prime commercial real estate market in Europe, with a presence in the main business areas of Barcelona, Madrid, Paris and Berlin. It owns a unique portfolio of commercial properties totaling more than 1 million square meters, with a gross asset value exceeding 12.0 billion euros. The Group follows a dedicated long-term strategy focused on value creation through a high-quality client portfolio and asset appreciation. Looking ahead, Colonial SFL will continue to lead the urban transformation of city centers in the European market, recognized for its expertise and professionalism, financial strength and profitability, while providing excellent sustainable real estate solutions adapted to the needs of its clients. Colonial SFL, Socimi S. A. was incorporated in Spain.
